result.Method of Attack: Remote access trojan that injects payload into msinfo32.exe; establishes persistence via registry keys and dropped copies (SMC.exe or SMC.cpl); downloads additional modules (e.g., fcd.dll, pcd.dll) from C2 server; performs file manipulation, registry manipulation, information stealing, file execution, process killing, and remote control; uses complex C2 communication commands to control victim systems; monitors victim's screen and controls computer via virtual desktop and screenshot streaming; disables browser protections and manipulates browser profiles to evade detection
result.Attack Vector: Distribution via malicious PDF containing shortened URL to password-protected .7z archive; extraction and execution of malware payload from archive; injection into legitimate process (msinfo32.exe); registry key manipulation for control and persistence
